judgments.quote: see whether P3 contests P1's 6 before committing
judgments.reason: The model explicitly says to wait to observe whether another player contests P1's committed 6 before committing, which articulates the mechanism that waiting reveals already-committed rival bids (as shown by the clerk's revealed committed bid in the transcript). The articulation links the mechanism (observing committed bids by waiting) to the observed outcome (P1's committed 6).
The model_articulation does not state that the 'close' action settles the game with unauctioned lots; no mechanism or link to such a terminal condition is articulated.
The model did not claim or explain that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; no articulation of this mechanism appears in model_articulation.
